deviations.reason: A floating-point SUM over Orders[Line Amount]: VertiPaq adds in segment order, DashCraft in row order, so the 15th significant digit differs (894300.500000003 vs 894300.500000001). The values agree within 1e-14 relative; FORMAT with General shows all 15 digits.

A field-parameter column (its groupByColumns make a composite key with Parameter Fields) cannot be aggregated alone in Desktop ('part of composite key'); DashCraft does not read groupByColumns and aggregates it.
